Computer Vision
Our vision systems enable robots to see, understand, and interact with their environment in real time. From 3D perception to facial recognition, our CV stack runs efficiently on embedded hardware.

Capabilities:
- 3D Perception
- Object Detection & Tracking
- Facial & Gesture Recognition
- Industrial Inspection

metadata.title: Computer Vision
metadata.keywords: Computer Vision | 3D Perception | Object Detection & Tracking | Facial & Gesture Recognition | Industrial Inspection

text:
Computer Vision — 3D Perception
Stereo vision, structured light, and LiDAR-camera fusion for accurate 3D environment mapping and object localization.
Technologies: Stereo depth estimation | Point cloud processing (PCL) | LiDAR-camera calibration and fusion | Visual SLAM (ORB-SLAM3)

Computer Vision — Object Detection & Tracking
Real-time multi-object detection and tracking using YOLOv8 and transformer-based detectors, optimized for edge deployment.
Technologies: YOLOv8 Nano to XL | DeepSORT tracking | ByteTrack | TensorRT optimization

Computer Vision — Facial & Gesture Recognition
Privacy-preserving facial recognition for personalized robot interactions. Hand and body gesture recognition for intuitive human-robot communication.
Technologies: ArcFace embeddings | MediaPipe holistic | Privacy-first: on-device only, no cloud upload

Computer Vision — Industrial Inspection
Automated visual inspection for manufacturing quality control — defect detection, dimensional measurement, and surface analysis.
Technologies: Anomaly detection (PaDiM, PatchCore) | OCR for part numbers | Thermal imaging analysis | High-res multi-camera calibration

text:
Robotics Engineering — Motion Planning & Control
Advanced trajectory planning and real-time control for manipulators and mobile platforms.
Technologies: Model Predictive Control (MPC) | Impedance control | Admittance control | Whole-body control | Trajectory optimization (TrajOpt)

Robotics Engineering — SLAM & Localization
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping for autonomous navigation in unknown and dynamic environments.
Technologies: LiDAR SLAM (Cartographer, FAST-LIO2) | Visual SLAM (ORB-SLAM3) | Visual-inertial odometry | Multi-sensor fusion (EKF, factor graphs)

Robotics Engineering — Manipulation & Grasping
Robotic grasping and manipulation for diverse objects in unstructured environments.
Technologies: 6-DoF grasp planning (GPD, GraspNet) | Dexterous manipulation | Force-feedback assembly | Soft robotic grippers

Robotics Engineering — Mechatronics & Hardware
Custom actuator design, sensor integration, and embedded electronics for our robot platforms.
Technologies: Custom BLDC motor drivers | FPGA-based real-time control | CAN bus / EtherCAT communication | Battery management systems (BMS)

Cloud & Data Platform — Digital Twin
Physics-accurate simulation of robots and environments. Test new behaviors, validate safety, and train AI models in simulation before deployment.

Cloud & Data Platform — Continuous Learning

Cloud & Data Platform — Analytics & Insights
Operational analytics dashboard showing robot utilization, efficiency metrics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance alerts.

Safety & Certification
Safety is the foundation of all our technology. We implement multi-layered safety architectures and comply with international robotics safety standards.

Standards:
- ISO 13482 — Safety requirements for personal care robots
- ISO 10218 — Industrial robot safety
- ISO 13849 — Safety-related parts of control systems (up to PL e / SIL 3)
- IEC 61508 — Functional safety of electrical/electronic systems
- IEC 60601 — Medical electrical equipment (for MediBot)
- CE Marking (EU), FCC (USA), MIC (Japan)

Safety Features:
- Multi-layer safety: hardware safety controller + software safety monitor
- Force-limited joints with real-time collision detection
- 360° LiDAR-based safety zones with configurable protective fields
- Emergency stop with < 50ms response time
- Fail-safe braking on all mobile platforms
- Redundant light detection and ranging for outdoor vehicles
